decisions.notes: Lead resolved from the city's own minutes. Sequence: June 8 work session discussion; June 22 adopted with unanimous consent on first reading (4-0); Aug. 10 first reading of an amended version (500-ft radius), with immediate consideration failing for lack of a second; Aug. 24 first reading again; Sept. 14 amendment exempting two projects adopted 3-1. The 180 days run from publication (date not found), so current_end_date_iso stays blank; the end is about late December 2026. Possible extra lead for the coordinator: at the June 8, 2026 work session Council member Hammann 'noted that Thursday marks 90 days under the current data center moratorium', implying an earlier standalone data-center pause around March 2026. The March 9 work session only discussed one, and no adopting instrument was found; worth one pass through the March-April 2026 council packets.
